bank.retain_mission: Extract distilled error root causes, bug post-mortems, verified test fix patterns, and diagnostic runbooks. Ignore raw verbose compiler stack traces, terminal log dumps, and routine build outputs.
bank.observations_mission: Track recurring bug root causes, flaky test behaviors, common environment pitfalls, and verified repair patterns across debugging sessions.
bank.reflect_mission: Synthesize a root-cause diagnosis and actionable repair runbook based on past verified bug fixes, post-mortems, and test failure resolutions.

mental_models.name: Verified Bug Fixes & Post-Mortems
mental_models.source_query: What bugs or test failures were previously resolved, what were their root causes, and what were the verified fix patterns?

mental_models.name: Diagnostic Runbooks & Environment Pitfalls
mental_models.source_query: What are the step-by-step diagnostic runbooks and environment fix patterns for recurring build or runtime errors?
